segments.text:
V. 23.
There was lying in the boſom of Jeſus—That is, ſitting next to Him at Table. This Phraſe only expreſſes the then cuſtomary Poſture at Meals, where the Gueſts all leaned ſideways on Couches. And each was ſaid to lye in the boſom of him who was placed next above him. One of the diſciples whom Jeſus loved—St. John avoids with great Care, the expreſsly naming himſelf. Perhaps our LORD now gave him the firſt Proof of his peculiar Love, by diſcloſing this Secret to him.
